# AI Learning Desk

> A free study page of flash cards on machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, language models and AI systems in production. Each card has a question, the idea, the technique, one example and one pitfall, in plain English.

The cards summarise public papers and official documentation in the author's own words. Cards with a link point to the original source. Examples use generated or illustrative data and make no claim about a real company, market or person.

The cards are licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: free to share and adapt for non-commercial use with credit. Commercial rights are reserved by the author. The page code is MIT.

## Canonical pages

- [The study page](https://imanslab.github.io/ai-learning-desk/)
- [Repository](https://github.com/imanslab/ai-learning-desk)
- [Licence notice: what is free and what is reserved](https://github.com/imanslab/ai-learning-desk/blob/main/NOTICE)

## Topics

- ML foundations, validation and metrics
- Deep learning, convolutional networks, recurrent networks and transformers
- Reinforcement learning
- Language models, agents and coding agents
- Time series, quant risk and simulation
- Experiments, monitoring, explainability and fairness
- Fuzzy logic and swarm optimisation
- Production, governance, trading and energy applications
